authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular architecture-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Simple rectangular shell; one broad entry opening, two residential windows on the north wall, optional non-operational masonry fireplace on the east wall. Ceiling fan is optional and disabled in reduced-motion mode. Target bounding dimensions 7.2m wide x 2.55m high x 5.8m deep. Materials: paint-warm-off-white. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
